parts.name: bell body

physics.Basic_description: The main conical/bell-shaped hull of the capsule, appearing tan/brown with a matte finish, forming the primary structure.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural volume for the crew and systems, and supports the heat shield and hatch.
physics.Grasped_description: Too large and curved for a standard gripper to grasp effectively; would require surface contact or specialized tooling.
physics.reason: Spacecraft pressure vessels are thin-walled shells enclosing a large air volume; treating as solid would vastly overestimate mass.

parts.description: The main conical/bell-shaped hull of the capsule, appearing tan/brown with a matte finish, forming the primary structure.

parts.name: hatch collar

physics.Basic_description: A metallic ring surrounding the hatch opening, appearing silver/grey, providing the mounting interface.
physics.Functional_description: Structural reinforcement for the hatch opening and mating surface for the hatch lid seal.
physics.Grasped_description: Curved ring shape makes it difficult to grasp securely without slipping.
physics.reason: Likely a machined solid ring or thick forging to withstand pressure loads around the opening.

parts.description: A metallic ring surrounding the hatch opening, appearing silver/grey, providing the mounting interface.

parts.name: hatch seal ring

physics.Grasped_description: Soft and flush-mounted; not a viable grasp point.
physics.reason: Seals are typically solid elastomer extrusions or molded rings.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
